content_zh:
但奇怪的是，宋家人虽然不给他饭吃，又是几年过去马真人竟然没有饿死，而是顽强的活了下来，这一年，他正好八十九岁。
这一年的冬天，马真人身体缩成一团坐在宋家大门口，因为天气冷的原因，他身体不受控制的索索发抖，双目已瞎，泛白的眼仁无神的望着前方，他并没有回到柴房，因为那里常年没有阳光照射，阴冷的如同冰窟，还不如坐在外面晒着太阳来的好。
就在这时，一个七八岁，浑身泥土，脏兮兮，鬼头鬼脑的小娃自宋家院里悄悄溜了出来，他叫宋二，是前几年宋家花钱买来的一个放牛娃，是个孤儿，因为无名无姓，宋家人都管他叫宋二。
宋二鬼鬼祟祟，左顾右盼几眼，伸出脏兮兮的小手，自怀里拿出一个冒着热气的大馒头，递给了马真人说道：“马爷爷，快吃吧，刚蒸出来的，热乎着呢。”
馒头被宋二漆黑的小手抓出几个指印，马真人接过去狼吞虎咽的大嚼起来，显然是好几天没有吃饭，饿得慌，那模样就好像一个饿死鬼托生一般。
吃完，他打了个饱嗝，抬起头感激的说道:“宋二，这几年都是你偷偷送饭给我，如果不是你，老头子早就饿死了，你的恩情我记下了。”
宋二嘻嘻一笑，伸手挠了挠后脑勺说道:“马爷爷说的哪里话，这几年都是你教我读书写字，你真有学问，都快赶上县里的先生了，我可不能眼睁睁的看着你饿死，以后还给你偷馒头吃。”
马真人伸手摸了摸宋二的脑袋，脸上露出慈祥的笑容，叹息一声道:“你这娃心地善良，可惜我算出自己大限已到，如若不然，我的一身本事到可传授与你，学些本事，总比一辈子当他宋家放牛娃来的好，可惜，已经没有时间了啊。”
宋二蹲在地上，托着下巴眼睛一眨不眨的看着马真人，根本不知道大限已到是什么意思。
与此同一时间，自大柳村的村头风尘仆仆赶来一人。
这个人三十多岁，浓眉大眼，一身麻布衣服，脚穿草鞋，肩上挂着一个破布袋子，身后背着一个用黑布包裹的东西，这一身打扮与乡下老农没有什么区别。
麻衣青年抬头望了望不远处的宋家大宅，黑黝黝的眉毛挑了挑，眼中闪过奇异之色，只见他伸手在额前一抹，随后向宋家大宅那里看了少许，喃喃自语道:
“此宅后有靠山，左青龙右白.虎，前有案山，中有明堂，且上空祥云汇聚，不出二十年，这家必定会出现大人物，我且前去讨一杯茶水，也好沾一沾福气，结个善缘。”
说完，麻衣青年面带微笑，向宋家大宅缓缓走去，可是令人吃惊的是，明明他身在大柳村口，宋家宅院在村中心，这其中距离足有千步之遥，只见他步伐轻盈，身子晃了晃，眨眼间便临近了宋家大宅附近，着实令人震惊。
当麻衣青年来到宋家大门前，看到宋二与马真人两人，顿时神色为之一愣，麻衣青年目光特意在马真人身上停留一阵，紧接着突然面色大变，上前一步抓.住他的手臂失声喊道:“师傅，你怎么会落得这番境地，你的眼睛又是怎么了？”
马真人听到来人声音，身子猛地一颤，泛白的双眼更是留下滴滴泪水，他握住麻衣青年的手，激动的说道:“玄英，我的好徒弟，你总算是回来了，要是在晚一些可就看不到老头子我喽。”
这个麻衣青年不是别人，正是马真人那个出去跑江湖，多年未归徒弟蒋玄英。
此刻他看着眼前如同乞丐般的老人，心如刀割，这还是我原来那个意气风发的师傅吗，我十年我没有回来，到底发生了什么？
蒋玄英深吸了口气，坐在马真人身旁，追问起了事情的缘由。
马真人叹息一声，将他替宋家选.阴宅之事如实道来，讲到宋家不守信用之时大呼后悔不已，说当初要不是自己异想天开的以为宋家会照顾自己下半辈子，也不会落得如今这等下场。

蒋玄英听完心中愤怒不已，大骂宋家人都是忘恩负义之辈，安慰马真人说师傅你别伤心，既然宋家对你不仁，就休怪咱们对他不义，徒弟我跑江湖这几年别的没学会，本事到见涨了不少，这口气我替你出。

content_en:
But the strange thing is that although the Song family did not give him food, Ma Zhenren did not starve to death after several years, but survived tenaciously. This year, he happened to be eighty-nine years old.
In the winter of this year, Ma Zhenren sat huddled in front of the Song family. Because of the cold weather, his body was shaking uncontrollably, and his eyes were blind. He stared blankly ahead with white eyes. He did not return to the woodshed, because there was no sunlight all year round and it was as cold as an ice cave. It was better to sit outside and bask in the sun.
At this moment, a seven or eight-year-old boy, covered in mud, dirty, and sneaky, slipped out of the Song family courtyard. His name was Song Er. He was a cowherd boy that the Song family bought with money a few years ago. He was an orphan. Because he had no name or surname, the Song family called him Song Er.
Song Er was sneaky, looked around a few times, stretched out his dirty little hands, took out a steaming big steamed bun from his arms, handed it to Ma Zhenren and said: "Grandpa Ma, eat it quickly, it's just steamed and it's still hot."
Song Er's dark little hands grabbed a few fingerprints on the steamed bun, and Ma Zhenren took it and wolfed it down. It was obvious that he had not eaten for several days and was so hungry that he looked like a starving ghost trying to survive.
After eating, he burped, raised his head and said gratefully: "Song Er, you have secretly sent me meals in the past few years. If it weren't for you, the old man would have died of hunger long ago. I will remember your kindness."
Song Er chuckled, stretched out his hand and scratched the back of his head and said, "What did you say, Grandpa Ma? You have taught me how to read and write in the past few years. You are so knowledgeable. You are almost as good as the gentlemen in the county. I can't just watch you starve to death and steal steamed buns for you in the future."
Ma Zhenren reached out and touched Song Er's head, with a kind smile on his face, and sighed: "You have a kind heart, but it's a pity that I have figured out that my time has come. Otherwise, I can teach you all my skills. Learning some skills is better than being a cowherd boy of the Song family for the rest of your life. Unfortunately, there is no time."
Song Er squatted on the ground, holding his chin and looking at Ma Zhenren without blinking. He had no idea what it meant that the deadline had come.
At the same time, a person came from the dusty village head of Daliu Village.
This man is in his thirties, with thick eyebrows and big eyes. He is dressed in linen clothes and straw sandals. He has a rag bag hanging on his shoulder and something wrapped in black cloth behind his back. This outfit is no different from that of an old farmer in the countryside.
The young man in linen clothes looked up at the Song family mansion not far away, his dark eyebrows raised, and a strange color flashed in his eyes. He reached out and touched his forehead, then looked a little towards the Song family mansion and murmured to himself:
"There is a mountain behind this house, with a green dragon on the left and a white tiger on the right. There is a table mountain in front, a bright hall in the middle, and auspicious clouds gather in the sky above. In less than twenty years, a big shot will definitely appear in this house. I will go and ask for a cup of tea, so that I can get lucky and form a good relationship."
After saying that, the young man in sackcloth smiled and walked slowly towards the Song family's mansion. But what was surprising was that he was clearly at the entrance of Daliu Village, and the Song family's mansion was in the center of the village. The distance was a thousand steps away. He walked lightly, swayed, and was close to the Song family's mansion in the blink of an eye. It was really shocking.
When the young man in Mai came to the door of the Song family and saw Song Er and Zhenren Ma, he was immediately stunned. The young man in Mai specifically stayed on Ma Zhenren for a while, and then his expression suddenly changed. He stepped forward and grabbed his arm and shouted loudly: "Master, how did you end up in this situation? What happened to your eyes?"
When Master Ma heard the voice of the visitor, his body trembled suddenly, and his white eyes were filled with tears. He held the hand of the young man in sackcloth and said excitedly: "Xuanying, my good apprentice, you are finally back. If it were later, you wouldn't be able to see me."This young man in sackcloth is none other than Ma Zhenren, who went out to travel around the world and had not returned to his apprentice for many years, Jiang Xuanying.
At this moment, he looked at the beggar-like old man in front of him, and his heart felt like a knife. Is this still the high-spirited master I used to be? I haven't come back for ten years. What happened?
Jiang Xuanying took a deep breath, sat next to Ma Zhenren, and asked about the cause of the matter.
Master Ma sighed and told the truth about the house he chose for the Song family. When he talked about the Song family's breach of trust, he cried out that he regretted it. He said that if he had not thought that the Song family would take care of him for the rest of his life, he would not have ended up like this.
After hearing this, Jiang Xuanying was furious and cursed the Song family as ungrateful people. She comforted Ma Zhenren and said, Master, don't be sad. Since the Song family is unkind to you, don't blame us for being unjust to him. Disciple, I haven't learned anything else in the past few years of running around in the world, and my skills have improved a lot. I will say this for you.
